content: Haven Real Estates is a boutique residential agency specializing in property sales, purchases, and quality long-term rentals.
Main office: 100 Haven Boulevard, Suite 400. Open Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Saturday 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Closed on Sundays.
Private in-person viewings are scheduled between 10:00 AM and 5:00 PM daily. Virtual video tours are available upon request through an assigned broker.
Buyers start with property matching and budget assessment. Once interested in a property, an offer is submitted through our licensed broker. Mortgage pre-approval is recommended before making offers.
Rental applications require government ID, proof of income (last 3 pay stubs or tax return), and standard credit check. Standard lease term is 12 months with a one-month security deposit.
Rental advisory is free for prospective tenants. Sales commission rates are tailored to property value and marketing requirements and must be discussed directly with an assigned broker.
We partner with trusted lending specialists who offer competitive fixed and variable mortgage rates. Our team can connect buyers with vetted mortgage advisors.
Complaints, formal offer submissions, legal/tax inquiries, and commission negotiations are immediately escalated to a human broker who will follow up within one business day.
